Line.DefaultText: The stall's turning a real profit these days, and everyone from the miller to the market vendor keeps telling me it's because word finally got around about this place. Every cottage, every well bucket, every fool commission the Professor's students dragged back from the hills, it all adds up to something. I didn't think I'd live to see this valley become a place worth writing home about, but here we are. Drinks are on the house tonight, don't argue with me about it.

Answer.DefaultText: I certainly won't argue with free drinks.
